We need to set up a tracked background job for our data preprocessing pipeline. Here's what I need done:

1. Register a new long-running job called 'genomics-data-preprocessing' with the worker command 'python scripts/preprocess.py --full-dataset --output data/processed/'.
2. Assign a unique session identifier to the processing worker — something that looks like a hierarchical agent path (e.g., using our internal session naming convention).
3. Assign a separate unique session identifier to the watchdog/monitor process that will oversee the worker.
4. Kick off at least one monitoring checkpoint so there's a record of the monitor doing its first round of observation.
5. Once monitoring is confirmed, finalize and archive the job with a completion summary that says 'Genomics preprocessing completed successfully — 120k records processed'.

Please make sure all artifacts end up in the right places so our infrastructure tooling can pick them up. The job tracking system is already installed on this machine.
